p.title: One filer reporting 13F dollar values 1,000x too high got both normal filers withheld
p.symptom: With two agreeing filers and one reporting 200,000 where 200 is normal, the two-peer median (their mean) made each normal filer look 1,000x too low, so all three were flagged.
p.root_cause: P1530 required two peers but did not require them to agree.
p.fix: With exactly two peers the comparison runs only when they are within 2x of each other; with three or more the median stays.
p.violated_rule: A withheld amount needs a reference the reader can trust.
p.prevention: ci-masters-contract-check P1560 high-direction fixture flags only the odd filer.
